artifact_scope: Original source analysis, standard-library replay code, arithmetic results, aggregate metadata counts, source identifiers and hashes.

source_licensing.SLST_JATS: The inspected JATS explicitly identifies CC BY 4.0; this package attributes Orcel et al. and links the source.
source_licensing.native_sources: Only original analysis, limited source phrases needed for replay checks, source identifiers and hashes are included. The cached McDonald representation is not publisher-original bytes. No broader rights to third-party bodies are asserted.

privacy: Clinical sample-name and isolate tokens are compared only within the offline verifier. Its output contains aggregate site counts, coded-subject count and pairing totals; no individual clinical token or source record is emitted.
